summary: This bill repeals the Public Utility Regulatory Policies Act of 1978 provision that established a federal standard for electric vehicle charging programs, along with related conforming amendments.

scores.thoughts: This bill repeals a standard related to electric vehicle charging programs. By removing a provision that encourages EV infrastructure, it indirectly disincentivizes EV adoption, which generally has positive environmental impacts compared to gasoline vehicles. Therefore, this bill pushes towards less environmental protection by hindering the transition to cleaner transportation.
